title: grading.toml
description: What the grading environment must provide to run the project. Parsed from TOML at the repository root.

external_secrets.description: Names of environment variables that carry the candidate's own keys for external APIs. Empty when the project runs offline. Names reserved by the grading environment are rejected.

egress_hosts.description: Lowercase DNS host names the running services call over HTTPS through the grading proxy. No scheme, port, path, wildcard or IP literal.

search_deterministic.description: true when GET /search returns the same ranking for the same input and the same data.

eval_deterministic.description: true when the eval service writes the same rankings for the same input and the same data.
